narrative.overview: A clinic scheduling interface that feels like walking into a trusted neighborhood practice — warm, grounded, and unmistakably real. The palette draws from the natural world of health and trust: deep forest greens that say 'this is a place of care,' warm golds that echo the clinic's name and the golden friendship it promises, and a cream ground that feels like sunlight on a well-kept waiting room.
keyCharacteristics: Forest green primary anchors every action and navigation element
Warm gold accent appears sparingly — pins, icons, links — never overwhelming
Cream ground throughout, never pure white backgrounds
DM Serif Display for all headings — personality without decoration
Warm shadows with visible offset, never cold gray halos
Consistent shadow-warm utility across all card surfaces
Page-enter fade animation for route transitions

rules.name: The Gold Sparingly Rule
rules.body: The gold accent appears on ≤5% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Warm Ground Rule
rules.body: Every background is warm. Pure white is reserved for elevated surfaces that need to visually lift off the cream ground.

rules.name: The Heading Font Rule
rules.body: DM Serif Display is used ONLY via fontFamily: var(--font-heading) applied through inline style.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: All numeric data columns use tabular-nums for aligned digits.

rules.name: The Warm Offset Rule
rules.body: Every shadow carries a visible Y-offset. Cold, centered shadows read as software. Warm, offset shadows read as object.

rules.name: The Radius Consistency Rule
rules.body: Cards use rounded-xl. Interactive controls use rounded-lg. Never mix.

dos: Do use fontFamily: var(--font-heading) via inline style for every page-level heading
Do use shadow-warm on every Card component
Do use tabular-nums on any element displaying numeric data
Do use the page-enter CSS class on layout content areas for smooth transitions
Do use the gold accent sparingly — one or two gold elements per screen maximum
Do use role="alert" on error messages and role="status" on success banners
Do include aria-hidden="true" on all decorative icons
donts: Don't use pure white as a page background — the ground is always warm cream
Don't use gray shadows — all shadows use the warm oklch family
Don't use DM Serif Display in body text, labels, or navigation
Don't scatter gold accents across a page
Don't use rounded-full on cards or containers
Don't use transition: all on any element
Don't add kicker lines, eyebrow labels, or section numbers above headings
Don't use gradient text, glass effects, or decorative blur
